headline: Middle schoolers turn NPR podcast's Spotify comments into a group chat
summary: Middle schoolers turned the Spotify comment section under an NPR podcast episode into an impromptu group chat, initially mistaken by NPR staff for bot activity. One outlet's reporting draws on a new This American Life episode in which host Ira Glass examines how the kids ended up there.

claims.statement: Middle schoolers turned the Spotify comment section under an NPR podcast into an impromptu group chat.

sources.quote: Kids turned the comment section of an NPR podcast into a group chat
The hottest new hangout for middle schoolers is NPR’s comment section?

claims.statement: NPR staff initially mistook the unusual comment activity for bots.

sources.quote: When NPR staffers flagged strange comments under their podcasts on Spotify as bots, it took a Gen Z colleague to (immediately) figure out the mystery.

claims.statement: The reporting draws on a new This American Life episode in which host Ira Glass examines how the kids ended up there.

sources.quote: In a new episode of This American Life, host Ira Glass digs into how the kids landed there and why.
